transactions.desc: The Reds placed Friedl on outright waivers Wednesday, Ken Rosenthal of The Athletic reports.
The Reds placed Suarez on outright waivers Wednesday, Ken Rosenthal of The Athletic reports.
The Diamondbacks released Littell on Wednesday
The Orioles selected Vazquez's contract from Triple-A Norfolk on Wednesday.
The Nationals recalled Perales from Triple-A Rochester on Wednesday.
The Athletics optioned Juenger to Triple-A Las Vegas on Wednesday.
The Athletics recalled Roycroft from Triple-A Las Vegas on Wednesday.
The Yankees signed Fulmer to a one-year contract Wednesday.
The Yankees recalled Rodriguez from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Wednesday.
The Yankees optioned Hanner to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Wednesday.
The Padres recalled Morgan from Triple-A El Paso on Wednesday.
The Marlins optioned Gibson to Triple-A Jacksonville on Wednesday.
The Marlins selected Monteverde's contract from Triple-A Jacksonville on Wednesday.
The Giants selected Roxby's contract from Triple-A Sacramento on Wednesday.
Atlanta claimed Vanasco off waivers from the Tigers on Wednesday and optioned him to Triple-A Gwinnett.
The Angels recalled Teodosio from Triple-A Salt Lake on Wednesday. He'll start in center field and bat ninth in the series finale versus the Guardians.
The Angels recalled Martin from Triple-A Salt Lake on Wednesday.
The Angels optioned Weiman to Triple-A Salt Lake on Wednesday.
Slater became a free agent after opting out of his minor-league contract with the Rays on Tuesday, Robert Murray of FanSided.com reports.
Melton (hamstring) went 1-for-3 with a solo home run and a stolen base Tuesday in his return to the Triple-A Durham lineup after being reinstated from the 7-day injured list.
The Nationals optioned  Bird to Triple-A Rochester following Tuesday's 3-1 loss to the Rockies.
Wynns and the Cubs agreed on a minor-league contract Tuesday.
The Pirates optioned Curtis to Triple-A Indianapolis on Tuesday, Colin Beazley of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.
The Pirates recalled Murdock from Triple-A Indianapolis on Tuesday, Colin Beazley of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.
The Giants recalled Bivens from Triple-A Sacramento on Tuesday, per Susan Slusser of the San Francisco Chronicle.
The White Sox recalled Cannon from Triple-A Charlotte on Tuesday, LaMond Pope of the Chicago Tribune reports.
Outman cleared waivers and was outrighted to Triple-A Toledo on Tuesday, Evan Woodbery of MLive.com reports.
The Rockies optioned Adams to Triple-A Albuquerque on Tuesday.
The Rockies optioned Fulford to Triple-A Albuquerque on Tuesday.
The Rockies selected Adams' contract from Triple-A Albuquerque, and he will start Tuesday's game against the Nationals.
